name: Unwelcome Guests
description: Unwelcome guests who touch this hatch are cursed.
disable: DC 28 Occultism (expert) to drain the magic from the curse, DC 31 Thievery (master) to unweave the curse's bindings, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 28) to counteract the curse
reset: The trap resets when the hatch is shut.

offensiveAbilities.name: Curse Trespassers
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the hatch

Effect The triggering creature takes (3d10+22) Force Damage damage and is knocked back 10 feet. A creature that succeeds at a DC 30 Will Saving Throw save takes half damage and isn't moved. On a failure, the creature is additionally cursed. A cursed creature takes a –2 penalty to Will saves, and whenever the cursed creature becomes affected by a spell, the creature takes 1d10 Force Damage damage. The curse remains until removed by Cleanse Affliction or similar magic.

Effect: Curse Trespassers
